workspace_files.text:
# Lumen Harbor June 13: seat shortlist

Quick brain-dump for the big night out. Will refine once
prices settle after the presale.

## Want

- **4 seats together** at **Chase Center** for **Lumen Harbor** on
  **Sat June 13** (doors 7pm). Jamie, Priya, Dev, Sam.
- Must include a **wheelchair-accessible spot for Sam**, with companion
  seats right next to it. Nobody gets split off into a different row.
- Budget is flexible but **cheaper is better**. Talked to Priya about
  upper-level accessible rows to keep it **under ~$100 each**. Open to
  going higher for the right seats; not interested in paying for
  premium stuff we don't need.

## Looking at (in priority order)

1. **Upper 212 or 214 accessible rows**: good sightline to the stage,
   wheelchair space plus companion seats, all four of us together.
   Probably ~$85-100 per ticket. Easiest win.
2. **Lower 118**: top of budget. Closer to the stage, but need
   to confirm there's an accessible space with companion seating next to it.
3. **Club Level 7**: nicer concourse and shorter lines, but pricier.
   Maybe, if the upper rows sell out.
4. ~~Courtside VIP package~~: way overkill for us, scratched.

## Getting there

- Taking BART to Mission Bay and walking over together.

# Night Out Plan: Lumen Harbor

Last updated: May 2026 (Jamie Rivera)

A running doc of what we've locked in for the big night out, plus the
open items still worth sorting out. I update this whenever the group
chat decides something.

## Main event

- **Lumen Harbor at Chase Center, San Francisco**, **Sat June 13 2026**.
  Doors 7pm, opener around 8, headliner around 9. This is the show
  we've been talking about since the tour was announced. I have the
  fan presale code from February (see ticket history), but the presale
  window closed before we'd agreed on seats, so we're buying through
  TicketHub now.
- Setlist rumor is that they're doing the full new album plus the
  older stuff Priya keeps asking for. Dev wants to be there early
  enough to grab merch before the line gets silly.

## Group

- **Jamie, Priya, Dev, Sam**, so **4 tickets**.
- Everyone has confirmed and Venmo'd their share. No plus-ones this
  time. We agreed to keep it to the four of us.

## Seating

- **Sam uses a wheelchair**, so we need a **wheelchair-accessible
  space** with **companion seats right next to it**.
- **Everyone sits together.** No splitting into two pairs, no "two
  here and two a few rows back." That's the whole point of going as a
  group.
- Upper-level accessible rows at Chase Center have worked well for us
  before (Upper 212 / 214, clear sightline, easy elevator access from
  the concourse). See the seat shortlist for options and budget.

## Logistics

- **BART to Mission Bay**, then walk over.
  Clipper cards are reloaded. Sam says the station elevators have been
  reliable lately.
- **Dinner beforehand** somewhere near Mission Bay. Priya is booking,
  around 5:30 so we're not rushing.
- Mobile tickets are fine. Everyone has the app. Send them to my email
  and I'll transfer.

## Open items

- Pick the actual seats. Cheaper is better as long as it's the right
  show and we're all together with Sam's accessible spot.
- Confirm dinner reservation once tickets are done.
- Figure out whether Dev is bringing the portable charger again.
